title: Decision: JMAP routes get their own body limit = maxSizeRequest
description: Audit item 10. DefaultBodyLimit::max(MAX_BODY_LEN) is layered only on the protocol sub-router (http.rs:93), so the JMAP routes would be unbounded. Chosen (Mark, 2026-10-18): the JMAP router (.11.2) gets its own DefaultBodyLimit equal to the advertised Session maxSizeRequest named constant; tests: a request exactly at the limit is accepted, one byte over is refused.
